strategy_roster.name: S4 IBS Mean Rev 3candleExit
strategy_roster.exit_long: close > sma(close, 3) or bars_since(close <= 0.75 * low + 0.25 * high) >= 3
strategy_roster.notes: IBS<=0.25 is written division-free as close <= 0.75*low + 0.25*high (documented IbsThreshold 0.25) and uses the current bar because the DSL cannot shift a computed series. Exit proxies 'close above entry' with SMA(3) and the 3-candle force exit with bars_since; the StartTime/EndTime window is not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Rsi Stochastic Wma
strategy_roster.entry_long: rsi(close,14) < 30 and bars_since(crossabove(rsi(close,14), sma(rsi(close,14),3))) < 5 and close > sma(close,21)
strategy_roster.exit_long: crossbelow(rsi(close,14), sma(rsi(close,14),3)) or rsi(close,14) > 70 or close < sma(close,21)
strategy_roster.notes: Stochastic %K/%D are approximated by RSI(14) and its 3-period EMA smoother (documented StochK 14 / StochD 3), with the cross allowed within 3 bars; WMA(21) is approximated by SMA(21). The short leg, 5-minute timeframe and no-stop rule are dropped for long-only DSL output.

strategy_roster.name: Bleris
strategy_roster.notes: The three-segment highest-high/lowest-low comparison is reduced to a single prior-segment extreme test; SignalBarSample=10 is an explicit fallback since the docs list the name but no value. CounterTrend reversal, Lots and the AnotherOrderPips spacing gate are not expressible, so only the long trend direction is kept.

strategy_roster.name: Stochastic Hook Reversal
strategy_roster.exit_long: roc(rsi(close,14),1) < 0 or rsi(close,14) > 80 or high >= donchian_high_prev(high,14)
strategy_roster.notes: A new 14-bar low with a rising one-bar oscillator change is the long hook reversal (%K turning up from below 20); the exit mirrors the hook and adds the overbought/new-high opposite. StopLoss=2% is documented, and the 15-minute timeframe plus short leg are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Golden Cross VWMA & EMA
strategy_roster.notes: VWMA is approximated by SMA(20) since volume-weighted averages are unavailable, and the 4-hour EMA is collapsed to EMA(10) on the daily bars; the long crossover enters and the opposite cross exits. No parameter values are documented and the short leg is not translated.

strategy_roster.name: Coensio Swing Trader V06
strategy_roster.notes: Long entry is a close above the 20-bar Donchian upper band (documented Channel Period 20) with the 15-pip Entry Threshold approximated as a 0.2% buffer; exit is a loss of the 20-period channel midpoint. Documented 50-pip stop, 80-pip target, break-even and trailing step are pip-based, so no percent stops are set.

strategy_roster.name: Price Extreme
strategy_roster.notes: Uses the documented LevelLength 5 with the prior-bar variant to honour SignalShift 1 (last closed candle) so the breakout compares against completed candles. ReverseSignals is false by default, so the long leg is used; StopLossPoints/TakeProfitPoints default to 0 (disabled) and OrderVolume/CandleType are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Balance of Power
strategy_roster.notes: Balance of Power is expressed division-free as (close-open) versus Threshold*(high-low) with the documented Threshold 0.8, keeping the documented cross semantics on both sides. The no-stop rule is preserved with null protection fields.

strategy_roster.name: Et4 MTC v1 Strategy (StockSharp Conversion)
strategy_roster.notes: The docs describe a skeleton template that generates no automatic entries and only replicates money-management helpers plus timing restrictions, so no market-derived long signal exists and the never-true close<0 guard is used. Trade entry/exit logic is explicitly left open for future development.

strategy_roster.name: UmnickTrader
strategy_roster.entry_long: sma((open + high + low + close) / 4, 2) >= sma((open + high + low + close) / 4, 4) * 1.002
strategy_roster.exit_long: sma((open + high + low + close) / 4, 2) < sma((open + high + low + close) / 4, 4) * 0.998
strategy_roster.notes: The average price (O+H+L+C)/4 is tracked with short and long smoothers, and the documented StopBase 0.017 move gate is approximated as a 0.2% shift. Long/short alternation after each trade, the eight-item profit/loss buffers, spread padding and self-managed price-unit TP/SL are not expressible, so a single long bias and null percent protection are used.
